root_cause.text: The cp2615 driver assumes the USB device serial string is always present and uses it as the I2C adapter name without a NULL check, causing a NULL-pointer dereference when a device lacks a serial number.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a guard `if (!usbdev->serial) return -EINVAL;` before the `strscpy(adap->name, usbdev->serial, ...)` call, and the commit message explicitly states "Verify that the device has a serial number before accessing it to avoid triggering a NULL-pointer dereference (e.g. with malicious devices)."
